name: Making models faster and more efficient
gist: Compressing and optimizing vision models so they run on limited hardware without losing accuracy.
explain: Modern vision models are accurate but expensive to run. A large model might require a high-end GPU and draw huge amounts of power. But computer vision needs to work on phones, in hospitals, in cameras, and in cars — devices that cannot afford to send data to a data center or wait for a slow model to finish. How do you run an accurate vision model on a phone with a battery that lasts all day? How do you process a live video stream in real time on edge hardware, where there is no cloud connection? This efficiency problem is as important to deployed computer vision as accuracy is because useless tools, no matter how accurate, get abandoned.

The challenge is a trade-off: smaller models run faster because they have fewer calculations, but smaller models are less accurate. Larger models are more accurate because they have more capacity to learn subtle patterns, but too slow to use on real devices. You cannot just shrink a model and hope; accuracy drops sharply. You need techniques that preserve accuracy while cutting size and speed. One approach is compression: remove parts of the model that do not matter much, or represent numbers with lower precision (e.g., use 8-bit integers instead of 32-bit floats). Another is architecture search: automatically design smaller models that are efficient by nature. A third is distillation: train a small student model to imitate a large teacher model, so the student learns to make the same decisions with fewer calculations. A fourth is efficient layer designs — convolutions that use fewer operations, comparison-based layers designed for speed, or neural operations that GPUs can parallelize well.

Papers in this subtheme focus on methods to cut computation or memory without sacrificing too much accuracy. Some use pruning: identify which weights or neurons matter least and delete them, reducing computation. Others use quantization: represent weights using fewer bits, shrinking memory and speeding up math. Some design new neural network blocks that do the same job with fewer multiplications. Others combine multiple techniques: start with a faster architecture (fewer calculations by design), distill knowledge from a large accurate model into it (so it learns better decisions), and then compress it further with quantization. A few study the fundamental trade-offs: how much accuracy must be lost when you cut size in half? What is the best speed-versus-accuracy pairing achievable? The goal is to democratize vision: make capable models run efficiently on any device.

papers.title: Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution with 3D Fourier Fields
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks with sharper and temporally more consistent reconstructions while being computationally more efficient.

papers.title: DeLiVR: Differential Spatiotemporal Lie Bias for Efficient Video Deraining
papers.contribution: Achieves sharper details, fewer rain remnants, and stronger temporal coherence on synthetic and real rainy benchmarks with improved efficiency.

papers.title: Improved Adversarial Diffusion Compression for Real-World Video Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: The resulting AdcVSR model achieves 95% parameter reduction and 8x acceleration over the DiT teacher while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency.

papers.title: Mobile-GS: Real-time Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Devices
papers.contribution: Achieves real-time rendering on mobile devices with high quality via order-independent rendering (eliminating sorting), neural enhancement, and compression techniques.

papers.title: PAGE-4D: Disentangled Pose and Geometry Estimation for 4D Perception
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms original VGGT on dynamic scenarios for camera pose, depth estimation, point cloud reconstruction, and dense tracking.

papers.title: PRISM: Synergizing Vision Foundation Models via Self-organized Expert Specialization
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art on PASCAL-Context and NYUD-v2, validating that sparse emergent specialization effectively integrates diverse visual knowledge.

papers.title: SEMA: a Scalable and Efficient Mamba like Attention via Token Localization and Averaging
papers.contribution: Outperforms recent vision Mamba models on ImageNet-1k classification at increasingly larger image scales at similar model parameter sizes.

papers.title: Toward Complex-Valued Neural Networks for Waveform Generation
papers.contribution: ComVo achieves higher synthesis quality than real-valued baselines and reduces training time by 25% through optimized block-matrix computation.

papers.title: Butterworth as Attention: Anisotropic Spectral Gating for Pansharpening
papers.contribution: ABFNet achieves state-of-the-art pansharpening performance with low computational overhead; superior CIFAR-100 classification validates broader applicability.

papers.title: CompoDistill: Attention Distillation for Compositional Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.contribution: CompoDistill significantly improves performance on compositional reasoning tasks while maintaining strong visual QA performance, with demonstrated effectiveness across backbone architectures.

papers.title: DocVAL: Validated Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Grounded Document VQA
papers.contribution: Yields 6-7 ANLS point improvements over comparable compact VLMs with student models that operate without OCR at inference, introducing mAP as a localization metric.

papers.title: EditScore: Unlocking Online RL for Image Editing via High-Fidelity Reward Modeling
papers.contribution: EditScore enables efficient online RL for image editing, with OmniGen2 achieving substantial performance uplift while demonstrating high-fidelity reward modeling.

papers.title: Efficient Audio-Visual Speech Separation with Discrete Lip Semantics and Multi-Scale Global-Local Attention
papers.contribution: Audio-visual speech separation (AVSS) methods leverage visual cues to extract target speech and have demonstrated strong separation quality in noisy acoustic environments

papers.title: Enabling True Global Perception in State Space Models for Visual Tasks
papers.contribution: GMamba, a plug-and-play module integrating GSSM into CNNs, improves performance on object detection, semantic segmentation, and instance segmentation tasks with efficient global perception.

papers.title: End-to-end Listen, Look, Speak and Act
papers.contribution: 4open

papers.title: Expressive yet Efficient Feature Expansion with Adaptive Cross-Hadamard Products
papers.contribution: ACH achieves state-of-the-art accuracy/speed trade-offs on image classification, establishing Hadamard operations as fundamental building blocks for efficient vision models.

papers.title: FARTrack: Fast Autoregressive Visual Tracking with High Performance
papers.contribution: Achieves 70.6% AO on GOT-10k in real-time with speeds of 343 FPS on GPU and 121 FPS on CPU.

papers.title: FastSESR: Fast Scene-level Explicit Surface Reconstruction
papers.contribution: Accelerates surface reconstruction by at least 20x over prior methods while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality on scene-level datasets.

papers.title: Feature Collapse Under Corruption: An Entropy Perspective on Robust Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Dem-HEC improves corruption robustness across CNNs, transformers, and foundation models (including DinoV3) while maintaining or boosting clean accuracy on datasets from small to large resolution.

papers.title: FideDiff: Efficient Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Image Motion Deblurring
papers.contribution: FideDiff achieves superior full-reference metrics surpassing diffusion-based methods and matching state-of-the-art models while enabling single-step inference.

papers.title: Hierarchical Image Tokenization for Multi-Scale Image Super Resolution
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results with a small 300M-parameter model, multi-scale outputs in a single forward pass, and no external training data requirement.

papers.title: LAMP: Data-Efficient Linear Affine Weight-Space Models for Parameter-Controlled 3D Shape Generation and Extrapolation
papers.contribution: Enables controlled interpolation with as few as 50 samples, safe extrapolation up to 100% beyond training ranges, and performance-guided optimization, outperforming conditional autoencoder and DNI baselines.

papers.title: LinearSR: Unlocking Linear Attention for Stable and Efficient Image Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: LinearSR achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality with exceptional efficiency, with core diffusion forward pass in 1-NFE and competitive multi-step inference time.

papers.title: Mixture of Mini Experts: Overcoming the Linear Layer Bottleneck in Multiple Instance Learning
papers.contribution: Across 8 MIL methods and 19 tasks, MAMMOTH improves performance more than changing the aggregation method, and simple pooling with MAMMOTH outperforms standard linear layers with complex aggregation.

papers.title: Preference-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Pluralistic Image Inpainting
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently produces higher-quality results across different backbone architectures such as Stable Diffusion and FLUX, significantly enhancing the

papers.title: Rethinking Attention in Spiking Transformers: Overcoming Density Bias with Set Similarity
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA mAP of 0.161 on AudioSet-20k with 54.3M parameters, outperforming prior SNNs and narrowing the gap with ANN-based models.

papers.title: Revisiting Coding-Based Approaches to Overcome the Curse of Dimensionality in Learning-Based Watermarking
papers.contribution: OrthoMark significantly improves the trade-off among visual quality, robustness, and capacity compared to prior methods, with particularly large gains in high-capacity regimes.

papers.title: SAGE: Spatial-visual Adaptive Graph Exploration for Efficient Visual Place Recognition
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA across eight benchmarks; notably 100% Recall@10 on SPED using only 4096D descriptors with frozen DINOv2 and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

papers.title: SHERPA: Fine-tuning Segment Anything Models with Task-relevant Guidance
papers.contribution: Enhances retention of generalization ability by up to 11.1% across diverse tasks while improving specific task performance by up to 2.2%.

papers.title: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
papers.contribution: Consistently improves strong baselines on long-tailed benchmarks by suppressing tail shortcuts through theoretical quantification and CAM-space distillation.

papers.title: Think in Cloud, Look at Edges: Semantic-Driven Query Decomposition for Efficient Video Reasoning
papers.contribution: SCOPE matches cloud-level accuracy with significantly lower transmission costs and outperforms baselines on Video-MME and LongVideoBench complex reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Visual Tracking with Dual Mixture-of-Experts
papers.contribution: OneTrackerV2 achieves state-of-the-art performance across five RGB and RGB+X tracking tasks with 12 benchmarks while maintaining high inference efficiency and strong performance under modality-missing scenarios.
